This album was certified platinum by the RIAA for one million shipments in the US.

The album was released in August 2004 and produced several singles that reached the Hot Country Songs charts, including "Ain't Got Nothin' on Us", "Friends", "How Was I to Know", and "I Miss You a Little", which peaked at #15, #2, #2, and #6, respectively.
